Commentary.Commentary: It's a good pitch for batting and Sri Lanka also have the firepower in their line-up. They will be backing themselves to overhaul the target but cannot afford to take the Zimbabwean bowlers lightly. Should be an intriguing chase. Do join us in a short while.

Sri Lanka did manage to pick a few wickets but Zimbabwe kept on building useful partnerships. There were four 50-plus stands in total and the ones involving Sikandar Raza provided the real impetus to the innings. The Lankans were disappointing with the new ball, pulled things back a little bit in the middle overs but once again fell flat at the death. Thisara Perera by far was the best bowler on show today, picking a couple of wickets and keeping it tight, yes you read it right, he was economical.

A grand finish by Zimbabwe - 48 runs in the last 4 overs. All thanks to Sikandar Raza, who continued his rich vein of form and played yet another scintillating knock. Put into bat, the Zimbabwean openers laid a strong platform and the middle order capitalized on it. Hamilton Masakadza was brilliant in his approach and played a crucial knock up front.
Very full outside off, Raza drives it hard but finds the man at extra cover. So a single to finish the final over. ZIMBABWE FINISH ON 290/6!
Fuller in line of the stumps, lofted over mid on. The ball doesn't have enough meat to cross the fence. They take a brace.
Graeme Cremer is the new man in.
OUT! Slower one around off, Moor clears his front leg to go big but ends up slicing it towards extra cover where Dananjaya backtracks, fumbles but does well to hold onto that one.
SIX! That's gone the distance! Asela keeps it full and wide outside off, Moor gets down on one knee and hits it straight down the ground. Has enough connection behind it to bag a biggie to his name.
Leg bye! Fuller on leg, Raza looks to slog sweep but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side.
Shortish delivery outside off, Moor drags it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a single.
A dot to end the over! Good length delivery, in the channel outside off, SR slashes at it but gets beaten. 11 off the over!

FOUR! That's a poor delivery! Raza won't mind it at all. He is on the charge! A waist high full toss outside off, Raza throws his bat at it. Slices it over backward point and picks up another boundary. 50-run stand comes up between these two as well.
FOUR! Drilled away! A half volley outside off, Sikandar Raza bends his back knee and drills off the carpet through extra cover for a boundary. He's piercing the gap to perfection here.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Yorker at the base of off stump, Raza jams it out towards covers for a single.
Keeps it full on middle and leg, Peter drags it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a single.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment. 12 off the over, 26 from the last two.
Sloppy from Mathews! Fuller in length and outside off, Raza drills it towards extra cover where Mathews misfields and lets it through his legs. Gives it a chase but they run a couple till then.
Worked away through mid-wicket for a brace. Good running!

Another run out chance missed! Raza is living a charmed life! Moor digs the yorker out towards Perera. Sikandar from the other end sets off. Perera collects the ball with a leap but misses the shy at his end. The ball rolls towards mid off and they run one on the overthrow.
Wide! Short and slower one again, Moor ducks and lets it be.
Fuller and angling in, Moor looks to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
SIX! Picks the slower one and dumps it! Perera bowls a back of the hand slower delivery, Moor waits for it and then hoicks it down the ground over long on for a maximum.
Thisara Perera is back into the attack.
The batsman gets a top edge on that one. One run added to the total.
Fuller on off, driven square of the wicket on the off side for a single.

FOUR! That's a blazing shot! Third of the over already! Back of a length and outside off, Raza shimmies down the track and belts it through extra cover for the third boundary in the over. Runs are coming thick and fast.

FOUR! Now this is some response from Raza! He was hit on the arm on the previous ball and now have a look at this! Shortish and angling in on the hips, Sikandar shuffles a touch and helps it through backward square leg for another boundary. 250 up for Zimbabwe!
Good ball! That must have stung! Short delivery and it climbs off the deck. Raza hops to fend it away but it hits him on the right arm and dies down.
FOUR! Easily done! Lakmal sprays one on the pads, Raza moves inside the line and clips it fine down the leg side for a boundary to begin the over.
Suranga Lakmal is back.

Chance of a run out! In fact, Sikandar Raza wasn't even in the frame. Big moment in the game, this! Flatter delivery around middle and leg, Sikandar goes back to turn it away on the leg side but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side. Moor calls him through for a single and Raza responds. Chandimal gets across to his right and hurls a throw at the bowler's end where Dananjaya fails to collect it. Had he collected and removed the bails, Raza would have been a goner.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Flighted delivery around off, driven straight to mid off.
Drops it short and down the leg side, Raza pulls it towards the man at deep backward square leg for one.
Leg bye! Fuller and around the pads, Moor fails to flick as the ball rolls off his pads towards the leg side.

Back-to-back fifties for Sikandar Raza! He continues to impress. But today he needs to stay till the end to help his team post a good total on the board. Akila drops it short on middle and leg, it's pulled behind square on the leg side for a single.
Akila Dananjaya comes back.
Fuller on off, driven-pushed towards mid off.
Bowls a leg cutter, gets deceived by it completely. Moor hangs his bat out to poke only to get beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length ball on middle, punched back to Perera.
Good length outside off, dabbed towards third man for one.
FOUR! Beautifully done! Perera fires in a wide yorker outside of, Raza crouches really low, opens the bat face and steers it behind point for a boundary to welcome Thisara back into the attack.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Leg bye! Drifting in on the pads, Moor tries to clip it away but misses. The ball brushes the pads and rolls towards square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Slower one, turning in a touch, Raza crouches low and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Wide!  The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Tossed up around off, eased down to long off for one.
Almost another! Raza just chips this full ball back to Gunaratne who leaps with his right hand up but luckily, for Raza, it evades him. A single taken.
Peter Moor is the new man in.

OUT! What a catch from Upul Tharanga! Sri Lanka have broken the 57-run stand! Asela Gunaratne serves a loopy full toss outside of, Waller gets down and plays the sweep aerially towards deep square leg. Tharanga in the deep moves to his left, keeps his eyes on the ball and then dives full length to take a lovely catch. Such kind of catches always lift your team.
Fires in a yorker on middle and leg, Waller makes room and pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Slower delivery on the pads, wristed behind square on the leg side for a single.
Wide! Short and outside off and it bounces way over the batsman's head. Raza just lets it sail over the Chandimal. The umpire calls it a wide but the Lankan keeper isn't amused.
Short of a length delivery on middle, pulled towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Shortish and angling down leg, Waller gets across the stumps to play the pull but fails to put bat on ball.
Angling in on the pads, worked away through backward square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Raza carves it over backward point and gets a couple for doing so.
Slants it in on middle and leg, tucked with the angle towards the man at 45.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up on off, driven towards cover.

NOT OUT! Missing leg! Quicker one and it skids off the pitch, Waller shuffles across to clip it away but misses to get hit on the pads. Asela appeals but the umpire pays no heed. He has a word with his skipper and then they take the review. Front foot is fine. But Ball Tracker shows it is pitching in line but would have missed the leg stump. Sri Lanka lose a review!
Sri Lanka have taken an LBW review against Waller. Seems like it is heading down leg.
Floats it up around middle and leg, tucked besides the pitch and Waller calls him through for a brisk single. Brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
Fuller in length and angling in, driven hard but straight to the cover fielder.
Strays a bit on the pads, deflected towards fine leg for another single.

In the air... safe! Shortish delivery, seems to have stopped a touch. Waller clears his front leg and goes for the pull but gets a top edge which lands safely near the backward square leg region. A single picked up.
Slower delivery, on the back of a length, Malcolm pushes it towards point.
Shortish and angling in on the batsman, Waller ducks under it.
Touch short and served outside off, slapped through cover-point for a single.
Length delivery on middle and leg, worked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
PowerPplay 3 signalled. Maximum of 5 fielders are now allowed outside the circle. Also, Dushmantha Chameera comes into the attack.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Gunaratne fires it quick on the stumps, Raza drives it to long on for another single.
Waller drives it down the ground and gives his partner the strike.
Floats it up on the middle stump, Raza drives it to long on for a single.
Tossed up delivery drifting down the leg, Waller clips it to square leg and the batsmen change ends.
Gunaratne darts it on the legs, Raza plays it to long on for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Lakmal bangs it short as it goes way above the batsman. The umpire calls it a wide.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery outside off, Waller pulls it away to the left of the mid on fielder to earn himself a boundary. Waller is looking to cut loose.
Lakmal bangs it short, Waller does well to duck that one away.
Lakmal bowls an off cutter on back of the length, Waller pulls it over the mid on fielder as they pick up a brace. His heart would have been in his mouth as the ball was in air for some time.
Raza pulls it to square leg for a single.
Lakmal bowls a short delivery outside off, Raza pulls it to mid on.
Gunaratne darts it full on the stumps, Waller manages to get that one away.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot but not in the gap, finds square leg.
Raza cuts it to the right of the point fielder and the batsmen rotate strike. 200 up for Zimbabwe.
Waller sweeps a full delivery to fine leg and gives his partner the strike.
Gunaratne drags it short on the stumps, Raza works it to square leg for a single.
Raza gets a inside edge and it hits his pads.
Asela Gunaratne comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Waller pulls the short delivery towards the left of the fine leg fielder. Chameera dives forward but the effort was not enough to save a boundary.
Lakmal hits the deck hard on the shorter side, Waller goes for the hook but misses it.
Raza played a pull shot towards square leg for a single to a delivery banged in short by Lakmal. Raza was going to fall on the stumps but somehow managed to keep the balance.
Lakmal drops short outside off, Raza punches it to covers for a brace. Good running by the batsmen.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Waller punches it off the back foot towards the cover area for a single.
Suranga Lakmal comes back into the attack.

FOUR! Good response by Raza. Full delivery outside off, Raza came dancing down the track and hit it past the covers for a boundary. That shot looked pleasing to the eyes and he had his dancing shoes on.
Floated delivery outside off, Raza defends it from within crease. Dananjaya managed to get some spin behind that one and it kept low as well.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Waller plays it to square leg and gives his partner the strike.
Dananjaya drags it short on the leg side, Raza flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single
Tossed up delivery on the legs, Raza hits it back to the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
In the air but safe. Chameera bowls it full on the legs, Waller chips it over the mid-wicket area for a brace.
Waller ducks to see off the bouncer by Chameera.
Waller works a full delivery towards mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Chameera lands it on a good length spot outside off, Waller gets beaten as he tries to put some bat to it.
Dushmantha Chameera comes back into the attack.
Waller sweeps the ball to the square leg region a single.

SIX! A good way to open the account. Dananjaya tossed it up outside off, Waller lofts it over the cover region for a maximum. He got some power behind that shot. A confident looking shot by him to get off the mark.
Waller tries to flick but it hits him high on the thigh pad.
Raza drives a looped up delivery to long on for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Not the kind of shot Zimbabwe would have wanted to see immediately after the fall of wicket. Raza reverse sweeps a tossed up delivery outside off to get it past the point region for a boundary. Raza needs to carry on till the end of the innings.
Malcolm Waller is in next. Meanwhile, Akila Dananjaya is back into the attack.

OUT! Huge blow for Zimbabwe. Just as they were trying to build on after Masakadza's loss they lose another set batsman. A beautifully bowled off-cutter on a good length spot outside off stump, Taylor tries to push that away to off side. But it curls back in and sneaks through the gap created between the bat and the pads. It brushes his back pad before hitting the timber. Their best bowler today has given them yet another breakthrough, a big one too.
Raza plays it to square leg for a single.

SIX! First one of the match. He gets some timing behind that one. Perera bowls a slower delivery full outside off, Raza lofts it over long off for a maximum. A picture perfect shot. The photographers are ready for the click.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, Raza plays it to square leg.
Taylor pushes a length delivery outside off to the cover region for a single.
A length delivery on the stumps to begin after the drinks break. Taylor defends it from within the crease. That one kept a bit low.

Drinks are on the field. With Masakadza throwing his wicket away, Taylor will look to notch a good partnership along with Raza as he is looking good in the middle. Sri Lanka have done better in the middle overs and would like to keep chipping away at the wickets.
Taylor flicks it down the fine leg region and will keep the strike for next over.
Short and dragged down the leg side by Chameera. The umpire calls it a wide.
Chameera bowls a back of a length delivery on the stumps, Taylor defends it to mid-wicket.
Raza rocks back on the back foot and punches it past the point region for a single.
Raza ducks to a well bowled bouncer.

Chameera banged it short outside off, Taylor plays an upper cut towards the third man fielder for a single. It was in the air but safe. Had he timed that one, it would have been straight down the third man's throat.
Taylor punches it off the back foot to the cover area.
Dushmantha Chameera comes back into the attack.
Raza pushes the ball to the cover region and a misfield allows them to complete a brace.

DROPPED! And guess who? Kusal Mendis. But it was a tough one. Raza flicks a shortish delivery on the legs to the square leg region. Mendis dives forward but fails to catch it. Maybe, it landed just short. Perera is not impressed. Raza needs to be careful here.
Raza opens the face of the bat and runs the ball to the third man area and they come through for a brace.
Length delivery outside  off, Raza goes for the hard slash but fails to put some bat to it. He needs to keep his cool.
Raza tries to punch the ball to the off side but manages to find an inside edge onto his pads.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, Raza defends it to mid-wicket.
Raza nudges a single to long on and will keep the strike for next over.
Taylor drives a low full toss down the ground and gives his partner the strike.
Short and wide, Raza cuts it to point and calls for a single.
Gunaratne bowls a low full toss, Raza punches it to the leg side.
Taylor chips it to the right of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.

FOUR! Cheeky by Taylor. Gunaratne drags it way too short outside leg, Taylor wait for it and paddle sweeps to get the ball past the left of the keeper for another boundary. Good improvisation by the batsman.
Raza lets this one go to the keeper. A tight over bowled by Perera. Only one from it!
Raza pushes a length delivery outside off towards the point region.
Perera bowls a back of a length delivery on the stumps, Taylor clips it to square leg for a single.
Taylor flicks a full delivery on the legs side to mid-wicket.
The batsman shoulders arms a length delivery outside off.
Perera drags it wide outside off, Taylor goes for the cut but fails to put some bat to it. He should have put that one away.
Thisara Perera is back on. By far, he has been the best bowler for Sri Lanka today, quite economical, which you normally don't associate with him.
Gunaratne gave some air to it as Taylor flicked it to square leg for a single. A successful over for the Lankans comes to an end.
Raza opens the face of the bat towards the point region to open his account.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.

OUT! Angelo Mathews brings on the man with the golden arm and he does not disappoint his captain. Tossed up delivery outside off, Masakadza hits it really hard but straight into the hands of Gunathilaka (sub) who juggles for the catch at mid off but manages to hold onto it. Masakadza did not get the elevation he would have wanted. He is disappointed with himself. Was batting beautifully and there was a century for the taking. Sikandar Raza comes in next.
Taylor drives the ball to long on to rotate the strike.
Gunaratne starts by tossing it up towards the batsman, he plays it to long on for a single.
Asela Gunaratne will roll his arm over for some off spin.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Taylor punches it off the back foot towards the cover region for a brace.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen change ends.
Floated delivery outside off, Taylor pushes it to covers for yet another single.
Masakadza rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Hasaranga drags it short outside off, Masakadza punches it past the cover fielder for a brace. This brings up the 50-run partnership between the two. They did make it look easy.
Wanindu Hasaranga, the leggie, comes back into the attack.
Taylor waits back and defends it from within the crease off his back foot. Good end to the over by Dananjaya.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Masakadza flicks it to mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
FOUR! Dananjaya tosses it up on the stumps, Masakadza chips it over the bowler for another boundary. The fielder running from long on had no chance of stopping that one.
Taylor drives it past the right of the bowler to give the strike to his partner.
Dananjaya floats it on the legs, Masakadza drives it to long on for a single.
Masakadza flicks it towards the square leg region and he will keep the strike for next over.
Masakadza pushes it towards the point region to register another brace to his name.

That could have been the shot of the day. Chameera bowls it full on the stump, Masakadza hits a lovely straight drive but unfortunately gets no run for it as it hits the stumps at the non-striker's end.
Wide. The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire signals it a wide.

FOUR! A classy looking shot. Chameera bangs it short, Masakadza was quick to see it. He waits on the back foot and pulls that one towards the leg side to pierce the gap between the mid-wicket and fine leg fielders for a boundary.
Masakadza punches the ball through the cover region for a brace.
Masakadza rocks back on the back foot and punches it to covers.
Taylor goes for the sweep to a floated delivery outside off, but fails to connect it. It hits him on his pads.
Taylor gets in the line of the ball and defends it off hits front foot.
Taylor drives the floated delivery to the mid on fielder.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Taylor flicks the ball to square leg and the batsmen quickly come through for a brace. Good running by the batsmen.
FOUR! Good looking shot by Taylor. Dananjaya tosses it up around off, Taylor gets on one knee and sweeps it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
A full delivery outside off to end the over with. Masakadza drives the ball to mid off. A good end to the over which started with a boundary.
Masakadza hits the ball to the mid-wicket fielder.
Chameera hits the deck hard towards the shorter side outside off, Masakadza punches it off the back foot towards the cover area.
Wide. The batsman watches the bouncer go way above his head. The umpire signals it a wide.
Taylor edges the ball to third man for a single.
Taylor waits on the back foot and punches it to the off side.

FOUR! Poor delivery to begin his second spell with. He drags it short and wide outside off, Taylor punches it through the cover region for a boundary. Good confident looking shot by the experienced campaigner.
Dushmantha Chameera comes back into the attack.
Dananjaya tosses it up down the leg side, Taylor works it to square leg and will keep the strike for next over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

NOT OUT! Taylor did manage to get some bat to it. He went for the reverse sweep but failed to connect properly. He was hit on the pads, they appealed and the umpire agreed. However, Taylor was quite sure as he took the DRS. The replays rolled in and the Snicko showed some spike when the ball passed the inside half of Brendan's bat. The umpire has to reverse his decision. Good use of the technology!
Shout for an lbw and up goes the finger. Brendan Taylor though refers it almost immediately. Has he under edged that?
Taylor tries to paddle sweep it, but finds the toe end of the bat to see the ball roll besides the pitch.
Taylor sweeps a floated delivery on the stumps towards the short fine leg fielder. Had me missed that one, he was a goner.
Dananjaya tosses it up outside off, Taylor defends it off the front foot.
Akila Dananjaya comes back into the attack. He went for plenty in his first spell. He would like to redeem himself in this one.
A short pitched ball on the stumps, Masakadza defends it from within the crease. This ball climbed on the batsman.
Masakadza punches the ball towards the cover region.
Lakmal bowls a back of a length delivery on the stumps, Masakadza defends it off his back foot. Lakmal did manage to get some bounce behind that ball.
Well played by Taylor. Lakmal hits the deck hard on the shorter side outside off. Taylor rocks back and gets the ball towards the third man region for a single.
Wide. Lakmal bangs it short and Taylor leaves that one away as it is way above him. The umpire signals a wide.
Lakmal bowls it full on the legs, Taylor plays it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Masakadza taps it to cover point for a single.
100 up for Zimbabwe. Masakadza drives the ball to long on and will keep the strike for next over.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Hasaranga floats it up on the legs, Masakadza leans into it and hits it to long on for a single.
Taylor drives a full delivery outside off towards long off for a single.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
FOUR! A juicy full toss and Taylor would not miss it. He flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for his first boundary of the innings.
Short pitched delivery on the stumps, Masakadza rocks back and punches it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Short ball, Taylor gloves his attempted pull shot towards short fine leg for a run.

32nd ODI fifty for Masakadza and 4th against the Lankans. Full length delivery outside off, Masakadza guides that one towards third man for a single. He needs to carry on from here and convert it into a big one.
A short of a length delivery on the legs, Taylor clips it to fine leg for another single.
Lakmal bowls it short outside off, Masakadza works it to third man for a single.
Taylor tries the reverse sweep to a floated delivery outside off, but only manages to glove that one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Masakadza leans into the drive and gets the ball past covers to give his partner the strike.
Hasaranga drags it short outside off, Taylor punches it to covers for a single.
Masakadza pushes the ball to the cover point fielder to rotate the strike.
Bowls it quick and full on the stumps. Masakadza defends it off the front foot.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes into the attack.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through. Good over for the Lankans.
Taylor defends it off his front foot towards the cover region.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Brendan Taylor comes in next.

OUT! Ervine makes his way back to the hut. Kusal Mendis will be a relieved man as that dropped catch did not cost them much. Lakmal bowls a short of a length ball outside off. Ervine goes for the punch but finds the outside edge of the bat. It flies to Angelo Mathews who completes an good catch at first slip. Three single digit scores for Craig in a row, going through a little bit of rough patch at the moment.
Ervine pushes the ball to the left of the point fielder and picks up a brace to open his account.
Lakmal lands it on a good length spot outside off. Ervine plays it off the front foot.
Suranga Lakmal comes back into the attack.

Drinks are on the field. Zimbabwe are 83-1. Masakadza is playing some positive cricket. He needs to carry on and score a big one for his team. Sri Lanka have been dismal, so far. Although, they got the wicket of Mire, they will be disappointed with the dropped catch of Ervine. Let's see how things pan out in the middle overs.
Masakadza goes for the back foot punch towards the mid-wicket area, but misses it as it hits his thigh pad.
FOUR! Chameera drags it short down the leg. Masakadza hooks that one away towards the fine leg region for another boundary.
Masakadza rocks on the back foot and punches the ball past the cover region. They pick up a couple.
Bouncer by Chameera. He bangs it short outside off, Masakadza goes for the hook but in the end decides to pull out from the shot.
Chameera bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, Masakadza defends it off the back foot.
Full down the leg side, Masakadza misses the flick as it hits his pads.
Bouncer to end the over with. Ervine does well to leave that one away.
Pitched up delivery on the stumps, Ervine plays it to Perera.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Ervine shoulders arms to a length delivery outside off.
Perera drifts it full on the leg side, Masakadza clips it to fine leg for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

DROPPED! Ervine gets a life on 0. Chameera lands it on a full length outside off, Ervine goes for the drives but finds the outside edge. The ball flies to the second slip region, Kusal Mendis gets hands to it but fails to hold on. Could be a costly drop for Sri Lanka.
Ervine shoulders arms to a full delivery outside off.
Masakadza drives it to mid off and gives the strike to his partner.
Chameera bangs it short, Masakadza ducks to see that one away.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Chameera bowls it full on the stumps, Masakadza flicks it off his pads to the leg side. Kusal Mendis makes a diving stop at leg gully. Had he not put his hands onto it, it was a certain boundary. The Lankans look all charged up.
Craig Ervine comes in next.

OUT! A much-needed breakthrough for the Lankans. These two batsmen were looking good in the middle. Perera bowls it on a short length spot around middle and off, Mire goes for the pull but finds the top edge. It skies up in the air and Kusal Mendis bags an easy catch running from mid-wicket to his right. Perera bowled a good over until then and the pressure got the better of the batsman. A 75-run partnership comes to an end.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Mire goes for the push to the cover region, he finds the inside edge and the ball runs to the leg side towards short fine leg.
Leading edge but safe. He bowls a seam up delivery on the stumps, Masakadza goes for the flick but finds the leading edge. It flies to the right of the point region and they steal a single.
Length delivery outside off, Masakadza pushes it to covers.
Masakadza drives it to the mid off area.
Mire pulls that one away over the square leg region for a brace. These two batsmen are looking good in the middle.
Chameera drags it short down the leg, Masakadza misses the flick. It hits his thigh pad and they sneak a leg bye.

In the air but safe! Chameera bowls a back of length delivery outside off. Mire goes for the push to the covers but finds the shoulder of his bat. The ball floats over the first slip fielder and the batsmen change ends.
Well bowled! The effort delivery by Chameera. Bangs it short right in the area. Mire goes for the hook but misses it. He is generating some good pace.
Chameera lands it on a back of a length, Mire punches it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on the stumps, Mire defends it off his front foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Wide called for height! Perera bangs it short, Masakadza ducks it and the umpire calls it a wide.

FOUR! Wide delivery outside off, Masakadza plays a square cut to get the ball past the point fielder for a boundary. The diving fielder had no chance to stop it. The outfield looks fast and the batsmen will get runs for their shots.
Masakadza rocks back and defends it off his front foot.
Mire drives the ball to mid-wicket and calls his partner over for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Mire pushes it to the point region.
Perera hits the deck hard on a shorter side, Mire goes for the hook but misses it. Umpire calls it one for the over.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper. At the end of Powerplay 1, the Men in Red are 64-0. Just the start they would have hoped for.
Similar delivery and similar shot by Masakadza. Length delivery on the middle stump, Masakadza flicks it over square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Good shot by Masakadza. Chameera bowls a length delivery on the middle, Masakadza flicks it to the left of the fine leg fielder to earn himself a boundary.
Wide! Chameera banged it short but that flew way over the batsman. A good collection by the keeper. That is one bounce for the over.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Masakadza plays it to the square leg area.
Short delivery on the legs, Mire plays it off his hips to fine leg for a single.
Chameera starts up by bowling it full and quick on the stumps. Mire plays it to mid-wicket.
Dushmantha Chameera comes into the attack.
Length delivery on the legs, Masakadza flicks it to mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Play and a miss. Masakadza goes to slash it towards the cover region but gets beaten by the inward movement on the ball.
LBW appeal by the player. Masakadza goes for the flick but misses it and it hits his pads. That was drifting down the leg side.
Masakadza shoulders arms to a delivery outside off.
Mire finds the outside edge to a delivery pitched on the good length spot outside off. The ball runs down the third man region and they pick up a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Dananjaya floats it full on the legs, Mire plays it with soft hands to the square leg region for a single.
Masakadza tucks it to square leg to rotate the strike.
Dananjaya drags it short, Mire pushes it to square leg for a single.

FOUR! Mire gets down the track and hits it past the bowler down the ground for yet another boundary. Mire is playing with positive intent. Good opening stand by the duo as they bring up their 50-run partnership in no time.
FOUR! Good shot by Mire. Dananjaya tosses it up on the stumps, Mire gets down on one knee and sweeps it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Good start to the over for the Men in Red.

A different Zimbabwe have turned up today for the game! There is better intent shown by their openers as they are trying to utilize the Powerplay overs. Not only the boundaries, they are concentrating on rotating the strike as well. Sri Lanka put under early pressure here.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Loose delivery and easy pickings for Masakadza. Perera bowls a short delivery on the legs, Masakadza rocks back and pulls it to square leg for another boundary. Masakadza is looking good in the middle.
Masakadza drives it to mid on.
Perera lands it on a good length spot outside off, Masakadza times it well but straight to the cover fielder.
Masakadza rocks back and defends off the back foot.
Starts up with a bouncer. That surprised the batsman. Perera banged it short on the stumps, Masakadza does well to duck that one away.
Thisara Perera comes into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Masakadza drives it to mid on and picks up a single.

FOUR! Innovative by the batsman. Dananjaya floats it around leg, Masakadza reverse sweeps that one to get the ball past the diving backward point fielder for a boundary. The batsmen are making use of the Powerplay overs.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Masakadza was not in control of it but gets four runs to his name. Dananjaya floats it up outside off, Masakadza comes dancing down the track and lofts the ball over the cover area for a single.
Mire comes dancing down the track and lofts the ball to deep mid-wicket. The batsmen run through for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to the point fielder.
Mire flicks it to mid-wicket and gives the strike to Masakadza.
FOUR! Mire picked that early and Lakmal paid the price for the experiment. He pitches the off cutter full and in the arc, Mire lofts it behind the bowler for a boundary.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Lakmal bowled it on a good length spot on the stumps, Mire finds the outside edge and sees the ball run past the second slip fielder for a boundary. He played it with soft hands.
Lakmal drags it short outside off, Mire punches it off the back foot towards the cover region.
Mire drives the full ball to mid on and he will keep the strike for next over.
Dananjaya floats it up outside off, Mire drives it to covers.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
LBW appeal by Akila but the umpire does not move an inch. Tosses this outside off, Mire goes for the sweep but misses it. The impact was outside off.
Bowls it quick and full outside off. Mire goes for the push towards covers but misses it.
Floats it full on the legs, Masakadza tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mire drives the full delivery on the stumps towards the mid off region.
Beaten. Lakmal pitches it in the driving length outside off, Mire goes for the back foot punch but gets beaten by the movement on the ball. Well bowled by Lakmal.
Drops it a tad short on the stumps, Masakadza punches it to mid-wicket and gives his partner the strike.
Wide outside off stump, Masakadza leaves it alone.
Lakmal  bangs it short outside off, Masakadza upper cuts this one. They pick up a couple as they ball flies over cover-point. Both batsmen look positive in their approach.
Lakmal hits it on the good length area outside off, Masakadza shoulders arms to it.
Dananjaya gives it some air but drops it short. Masakadza punches it towards mid-wicket as they pick up a brace.
The batsman has flicked this off his pads.
FOUR! Lovely shot by Mire. Gunaratne tosses it up outside off, Mire gets on top of the ball and sweeps it past the square leg region to earn his first boundary.
Drags it a bit short on the stumps, Masakadza clips it to fine leg for a single.
Floated delivery outside off, Mire leans forward on the front foot to defend. But he gets an inside edge and they sneak a single as the ball runs to square leg.
Dananjaya tosses the delivery towards the batsman, Mire tucks it to square leg.
Akila Dananjaya will bowl from other end.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump. Good beginning by Zimbabwe, way better than the last ODI where they lost two wickets in the opening over!
Good follow up delivery by Lakmal. On a good length spot outside off, Masakadza goes for the drive but gets beaten.
FOUR! Lakmal drags it full down the leg side, Masakadza was quick to it and flicks it past the square leg region for yet another boundary. He timed that one beautifully.
Lakmal drags it short down the leg side, Masakadza tucks it to the square leg area.
FOUR! First runs for Zimbabwe. Lakmal gives a half volley on the stumps, Masakadza punches it down the ground to open his account with a boundary.
Good delivery to begin with. Lakmal pitches it full outside off, Masakadza drives it to mid off. A good looking shot to start the proceedings with.
The umpires make their way out in the middle. Hamilton Masakadza and Solomon Mire will open the innings for Zimbabwe. Suranga Lakmal will have the new ball in hand to start the proceedings.

Sri Lanka XI - Upul Tharanga, Kusal Perera, Dinesh Chandimal (wk), Angelo Mathews (c), Kusal Mendis, Asela Gunaratne, Thisara Perera, Akila Dananjaya, Suranga Lakmal, Wanindu Hasaranga, Dushmantha Chameera.
Zimbabwe XI -  Hamilton Masakadza, Solomon Mire, PJ Moor, Brendan Taylor (wk), Craig Ervine, Sikandar Raza, Malcolm Waller, Graeme Cremer (c), Kyle Jarvis, Tendai Chatara, Blessing Muzarabani.
TOSS - Both the skippers come out along with the match referee David Boon (officiating his 100th ODI). Angelo Mathews flips the coin, Graeme Cremer calls it wrongly and Sri Lanka opt to field first!

We expect a crackerjack of a match as the Men in Red look to make a comeback after a defeat while the Lankan Lions will look to start the tournament on a high, once again under the captaincy of Angelo Mathews. Join us shortly for toss and action.

On the other hand, Sri Lanka look a much better side on paper. The experience of Upul Tharanga at the top of the order who has been in red-hot form lately having scored 95 in his last ODI will look to provide a good start for his team. The Lankan Lions will go into this match with their confidence boosted due to the newly appointed coach, Chandika Hathurusingha, who was with the Bangladesh team for the last three years and will be knowing nook and corner of these conditions.

Hello folks, we are here at Shere Bangla National Stadium, Dhaka, for the historic 100th ODI to be played here. Sri Lanka will be taking on Zimbabwe in the second match of the tri-nation series. Zimbabwe, after having suffered a huge loss in the first match, will look to pull up their socks in this encounter. The only positive they had was the stability provided by Sikandar Raza and Peter Moor.
